newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ICI mulls A$100 mln Asian expansion.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ICI mulls A$100 mln Asian expansion.

text.p: Chemicals group ICI Australia Ltd was looking at a further A$100 million capital expansion into Asia in the next year, managing director Warren Haynes said on Sunday.

"We have made a tentative step into Asia with some acquisitions last year and further investments in explosives in Asia but we would expect over the next 12 months to improve the amount of investment that we are making in Asia," Haynes said in a television interview.
Asked how much investment ICI was planning, Haynes said it could be up to A$100 million.

"It depends on opportunities that we are investigating at the moment coming off but if that were to happen during next year, it could be a third of our capital programme," he told the Business Sunday programme.
ICI is 62.5 percent owned by Imperial Chemical Industries Plc.

The company spent around A$20 million in 1995/96 (October-September) in Asia, where it invested in a polyethylene manufacturer in Malaysia, a resin plant in China and explosives production in Indonesia.
Last month ICI said its 1995/96 net profit fell 26.7 percent to A$197.1 million.
ICI shares last traded at A$12.15 on Friday, down 25 cents on the day. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 373-1800
